A [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who was present in the courtroom of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]] on the planet [[Tarnoonga/Legends|Tarnoonga]].

==Biography==
A member of the the crew of Kybo Ren-Cha, this pirate witnessed the interrogation of [[Jann Tosh]] before the young [[Miner/Legends|miner]] was taken by [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] to be thrown to the [[Miridon]].

==Behind the scenes==
This pirate, whose physical appearance is similar to the [[Brizzit]] species, appeared only in the book [[The Pirates of Tarnoonga: A Droid Adventure]] and was not present in the [[Pirates of Tarnoonga]] television episode.

==Appearances==
*''[[The Pirates of Tarnoonga: A Droid Adventure]]''
